prediction_origin: native frame received_at (client monotonic, same clock domain)

labels.first_content: client HTTP first_content_at - t0, only while Gateway has not observed first content by t0
labels.terminal: client HTTP terminal_at - t0 for Gateway-admitted in-flight requests

fit: non-negative least squares, fixed ridge on non-intercept coefficients, request-weighted

baselines.elapsed: max(training mean total residence since Gateway accept - elapsed, 0)
baselines.persistence: max(latest realized Gateway residence in this episode before t0 - elapsed, 0); training mean total residence if none realized yet

feature_availability.native_frame: native snapshot sampled_at <= frame received_at (t0); received_at is the asynchronous client receipt time, not a synchronized Gateway decision time
feature_availability.gateway_events: UNVERIFIED oracle retrospective reconstruction: Gateway telemetry effective timestamps <= t0 do not establish that a client/controller could consume those events at t0; no Gateway-snapshot receipt times were recorded. These are not qualified online-available causal inputs.
feature_availability.online_qualification_requirement: future collection must record Gateway-snapshot receipt times; until then this diagnostic remains unaccepted

coefficient_note: A zero/negligible fitted coefficient (e.g. own_cap_x_native_decode_batch) means the constrained fit assigned it no weight; the feature values themselves are not always zero (see feature_value_ranges).
eligibility: Residence samples cover only Gateway-admitted requests in flight at a frame (first-content additionally only before Gateway first content); rejected and between-frame requests are counted, not predicted.

exclusions.rejected_requests: no residence label; excluded from residence samples, retained in counts

first_content.label: in-sample training fit; not a generalisation estimate

terminal.label: in-sample training fit; not a generalisation estimate

combined_limitations: Intervention arms are schedule arms (budget varies inside an episode); arm labels, not fixed budgets, define the pair held out with each seed block.
Scout cells are each covered by one scout seed; whether a held scout block has an independent same-cell seed depends on the intervention cells (see per_episode).
Eligible admitted requests only; outcomes of rejected offers are not predicted.
Native frame received_at timestamps are asynchronous client receipt times.
Train-only; no Calibration/Validation/Test data are read or produced.
limitations: 8 independent seed blocks (4 scout + Train interventions); see combined_support for whether each held block has same-cell training seeds.
Samples within a request/frame/episode are strongly dependent; sample counts are not independent replicates. No standard errors, intervals or calibration are claimed.
Error quantiles are descriptive held-out residuals, not statistically guaranteed bounds.

Retrospective Train-only data: scout fixed budgets 16/32 plus intervention arms whose budget varies within episode; no online-issued forecasts, no native Calibration/Test split, no causal effect of actions identified.
Remaining output cap is an upper bound; natural EOS length is not observed at t0.
Waiting requests are counts only in native frames; per-request waiting state is Gateway-side.
Client-side labels include detokenisation/streaming delay after engine work.

offer_accounting.note: every offer is complete or rejected; rejected offers and admitted requests never in a risk set are counted, not predicted
